mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer-driven companies report lower earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals a potential for monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real interest rates decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over two months signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as both consumer and business confidence improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases over 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDP shows sustained growth.
